summary:
All plan items are present and covered by regression tests.
- src/awf/profiles/models.py: EgressAllowlistTemplate enum added; ProfileEgress gains allowlist_templates (default []) and open_explanation (default None, max_length 512).
- src/awf/node/egress_policy.py: local_egress_plan preserves allowlist_templates in LocalEgressPlan.details for restricted mode.
- src/awf/service/profile_metadata.py: egress_allowlist_templates_from_profile_snapshot extracts templates from resolved-profile JSON snapshots.
- src/awf/profiles/onboarding.py: _DEFAULT_RESTRICTED_ALLOWLIST_TEMPLATES defined; _profile_for_template sets restricted mode + all templates on every draft profile.
- src/awf/service/status.py: _network_posture_check_payload includes active_restricted_templates and deferred_enforcement_note.
- src/awf/service/doctor/__init__.py: network_posture diagnostic forwards status payload metadata unchanged into diagnostic output.
- src/awf/service/orphans.py: WorkspaceLifecycleSnapshot extended with allowlist_templates.
- .awf/workspace.yml: open_explanation documents why self-dogfood stays open.
- Regression tests exist for: enum roundtrip (test_egress_allowlist_template_enum_roundtrips), schema parsing (test_profile_egress_parses_allowlist_templates_and_open_explanation), local plan details (test_local_egress_plan_restricted_includes_templates_in_details), onboarding defaults (test_onboarding_restricted_draft_includes_default_allowlist_templates), open explanation (test_onboarding_open_profile_can_carry_open_explanation), snapshot extraction (test_extracts_allowlist_templates_from_profile_snapshot), backward compatibility (test_returns_none_for_missing_templates), status payload (test_network_posture_payload_includes_restricted_templates, test_network_posture_payload_aggregates_restricted_templates), and doctor metadata pass-through (test_doctor_network_posture_metadata_surfaces_templates).
- Existing validation evidence from commit bc9a51e: narrow pytest suite 127 passed, ruff clean, mypy clean, broader pytest --cov=awf at 98.92% (same baseline).
- No new EgressMode values, no cloud NetworkPolicy/iptables/proxy implementation, no console changes, default EgressMode unchanged. All non-goals respected.
